comment: Template for the production release signing configuration.
Copy this file OUTSIDE the repository (for example to the signing workstation's protected
config directory), replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with the confirmed value, and pass the copy to
THIS FILE MUST NEVER CONTAIN A SECRET. No PIN, no token password, no PFX password, no HSM
credential, no API key. New-ReleaseSigningOption rejects the configuration if a secret-looking
key or a secret-carrying signtool argument is present, and refuses to run while any required
The certificate vendor, the issuing CA subject and the RFC 3161 timestamp URL are deliberately
left as placeholders: they are filled in only once the actual certificate provider and
timestamp service have been confirmed during procurement.
Recorded for release evidence only; never used to authenticate. Values are non-secret
descriptors of where the private key lives and who is allowed to operate it.
